introduction: Virginia SNAP helps approved households buy eligible food using EBT. Local DSS determines the household benefit.
description: Virginia SNAP helps approved households buy eligible food using EBT. Local DSS determines the household benefit.

sections.who: Household income, size, allowable deductions and applicable program rules affect eligibility. Some households have categorical eligibility routes.
sections.get: Monthly grocery support depends on the case. Use current rules rather than an expired income or benefit table.
sections.docs:
• Household identity and income records.
  • Housing and applicable expense evidence.
  • Requested status and other verification.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use CommonHelp or ask local DSS for paper intake.

  2. Complete follow-up

    Attend requested interviews and return evidence. Explain an urgent lack of food.

  3. Read the decision

    Check the approved amount, EBT instructions and reporting duties.
sections.after: VaCAP ended June 1, 2026. Former VaCAP cases move to ESAP assessment at recertification and may need additional income and expense information.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using VDSS SNAP; State food assistance intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is a prior VaCAP fixed amount guaranteed?
No. ESAP assessment calculates benefits from income and allowable expenses.
Does an old table determine my benefit?
Use the current agency assessment and notice.
Follow the recertification checklist, particularly if transitioning from VaCAP.
